items.title_orig: OMG THEY ACTUALLY PUT THE SONG IN
items.article_text:
Was doing one of the line challenges on the new map and one attempt I did a random christ air flip and heard "Even Flow" start to play. Come to find out. IT'S ACTUALLY A SONG THAT WAS ADDED. It's in teh Fresh Baked Bops playlist, song 11 even you wanna look for it
    submitted by    /u/DarkPrinceSora1    to    r/Skate4  
 [link]   [comments]

Just skating around I hit the Christ air and even flow by Pearl Jam started playing, I know about the meme skate Jesus I was just not expecting to hear that haha I think it’s rare because I hit Christ air multiple times and no music it’s probably like battlefield with those rare reloading animations 
    submitted by    /u/imbrofessorx    to    r/Skate4  
 [link]   [comments]
